paragraphs: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. ( SAKS) is an American multinational investment bank and financial services company. It was founded in 1869 and is headquartered in the Battery Park City neighborhood of Manhattan in New York City, with offices in many financial centers worldwide. Goldman Sachs is one of the largest investment banks by revenue. It is ranked 32nd on the Fortune 500 and 19th on the Forbes Global 2000. It is considered a systemically important financial institution by the Financial Stability Board.

The company receives revenues from market making for many types of financial products (31% of 2025 revenues); net interest income (23% of 2025 revenues); investment management and wealth management (20% of 2025 revenues); investment banking (advisory for mergers and acquisitions and restructuring and securities underwriting, including initial public offerings) (16% of 2025 revenues); commissions and fees for clearing financial transactions (7% of 2025 revenues); and proprietary trading (3% of 2025 revenues).

people.name: Denis P. Coleman III
people.title: Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Previously served as Deputy Chief Financial Officer from September 2021 and Co-Head of the Global Financing Group from June 2018 to September 2021. Earlier led the EMEA Financing Group and EMEA Credit Finance.
people.quote: Mr. Coleman has been Chief Financial Officer since January 2022.

people.name: Sheara J. Fredman
people.title: Controller and Chief Accounting Officer
people.bio: Previously served as Head of Regulatory Controllers from September 2017 and, before that, as Global Product Controller.
people.quote: Ms. Fredman has been Controller and Chief Accounting Officer since November 2019.

people.name: Alex Golten
people.title: Chief Risk Officer
people.bio: Previously served as Head of Finance Risk, Head of Enterprise Risk and Chief Market Risk Officer. He was Chief Credit Risk Officer from January 2018 to April 2021.
people.quote: Mr. Golten has been Chief Risk Officer since January 2025.

people.name: Carey Halio
people.title: Global Treasurer
people.bio: Previously served as Chief Strategy Officer and Global Head of Investor Relations. Earlier roles included Chief Executive Officer of GS Bank USA, Deputy Treasurer and Chief Financial Officer of GS Bank USA.
people.quote: Ms. Halio has been Global Treasurer since May 2024.

people.name: John F.W. Rogers
people.title: Executive Vice President and Secretary to the Board
people.bio: Has served as Executive Vice President since April 2011 and Secretary to the Board since December 2001. Also served as Chief of Staff from December 2001 to September 2023.
people.quote: Mr. Rogers has been an Executive Vice President since April 2011 and Secretary to the Board since December 2001.

people.name: Kathryn H. Ruemmler
people.title: Chief Legal Officer, General Counsel and Secretary
people.bio: Previously served as Global Head of Regulatory Affairs from April 2020 and as a Litigation Partner at Latham & Watkins LLP from June 2014 to April 2020. She will retire from her current roles on June 30, 2026.
people.quote: Ms. Ruemmler has been the Chief Legal Officer, General Counsel and Secretary since March 2021

people.name: David Solomon
people.title: Chairman of the Board and Chief Executive Officer

people.quote: Mr. Solomon has been Chairman of the Board since January 2019 and Chief Executive Officer and a director since October 2018.
